QQAdapter — OneBot v11 style channel adapter.

Receiving: startWebhook(port) launches an embedded HTTP server on a dedicated OS thread. It accepts POST requests from the OneBot bridge and pushes parsed events into a thread-safe Channel drained by tryRecvEvent().

For testing or external forwarding, enqueueEventJson() accepts raw JSON directly without going through the HTTP path.

Sending: Uses OneBot HTTP APIs with Bearer token authentication.
